snippet.description:
UPSC Prelims Strategy 2027: Learn how AIR 100 Sattwik Satyakam Devta cleared UPSC Prelims in all 6 attempts and built a strategy focused on accuracy, PYQs, revision and mock analysis.

Enroll Now in LevelUp Mentorship Program (LMP) 2027: https://shorturl.at/dlQXj
Queries? Call at 8826496658

In this complete UPSC Prelims strategy session, he explains:

• How to analyse UPSC Prelims PYQs
• How to use intelligent elimination without random guessing
• How many questions to attempt in Prelims
• How to analyse mock tests properly
• How to improve accuracy and reduce negative marking
• How to approach CSAT safely
• How to revise Current Affairs effectively
• How to plan the final 75 days before UPSC Prelims
• How to balance Prelims and Mains preparation

Sattwik also shares why there is no “magic number” of attempts and why mock-test analysis matters more than simply giving more tests.

If you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2027, this session will help you build a practical and repeatable UPSC Prelims preparation strategy.

🔍Get a FREE 1-to-1 Mentorship Session with real teachers and senior mentors: https://shorturl.at/uBnu0

Meet us - 📍Location: LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre; Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/6brt5mwLSFhENRCq8
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh
